description: Organize the purchased, licensed ElvGames collection as APK's single standard asset library with filesystem-derived semantic keys, view and cell-size taxonomy, attribution, validation, and curated ingestion batches.
deviation_notes: Rebased by product decision on 2026-07-23: the purchased ElvGames library supersedes the speculative Chibi Quest/Riven Lands generated-art plan. The shared library foundation may proceed now; cartridge adoption remains separately gated.
